# Tesla and General Motors Annual Revenue Comparison (2020-2024)

**Supported**

TSLA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $97.690 billion [E06fb99d6f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), up from $96.773 billion for 2023-12-31 [E11b4f42020](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). TSLA net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $7.091 billion [E882dff63b5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), down from $14.997 billion for 2023-12-31 [E67dab066ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). TSLA cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $11.339 billion [Efe9447dc7f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html), up from $8.898 billion for 2023-12-31 [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). The retrieved outlook gave a capital-spending range of $7.000 billion to $9.000 billion for the year ending 2023-12-31 [E50fb1d1470](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023033872/tsla-20230630.htm). Reported cash PP&E purchases were $8.898 billion, within quoted range [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of January 1, 2024, historical annual financial results for both Tesla and General Motors were fully reported for fiscal years spanning 2020 through 2022, with 2023 filings arriving shortly thereafter [E53ae19594b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000156459021004599/0001564590-21-004599-index.html) [E45b519a9ca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022000796/0000950170-22-000796-index.html) [Ef9163ebd5b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/0000950170-23-001409-index.html) [E2244998b29](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785821000037/0001467858-21-000037-index.html) [E8c222bb319](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785822000034/0001467858-22-000034-index.html) [E79475160fb](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785823000029/0001467858-23-000029-index.html). Management disclosures from Tesla outlined capital expenditure expectations between $7.00 and $9.00 billion for 2023 and subsequent years [E50fb1d1470](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023033872/tsla-20230630.htm). Similarly, General Motors provided forward-looking commentary on cost reductions, EV supply funding, and expected contract liability revenue recognition [Ee914f2fd7c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785823000107/gm-20230930.htm) [E5d63869c15](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785823000107/gm-20230930.htm).

## What happened later

Subsequent financial reporting confirmed that Tesla's annual revenue grew from $31,536,000,000 in 2020 to $97,690,000,000 in 2024 [E53ae19594b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000156459021004599/0001564590-21-004599-index.html) [E06fb99d6f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html). General Motors reported annual revenue expanding from $122,485,000,000 in 2020 to $187,442,000,000 in 2024 [E2244998b29](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785821000037/0001467858-21-000037-index.html) [E16ec1705e6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/0001467858-25-000032-index.html). Tesla's capital expenditures for the 2023 fiscal year reached $8,898,000,000, aligning with management's previously stated forecasts [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [E50fb1d1470](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023033872/tsla-20230630.htm).

## The peer test

Comparing annual revenue periods ending on 2020-12-31, Tesla reported $31,536,000,000 compared to General Motors' $122,485,000,000 [E53ae19594b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000156459021004599/0001564590-21-004599-index.html) [E2244998b29](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785821000037/0001467858-21-000037-index.html). For the fiscal period ending 2021-12-31, Tesla reported $53,823,000,000 versus General Motors' $127,004,000,000 [E45b519a9ca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017022000796/0000950170-22-000796-index.html) [E8c222bb319](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785822000034/0001467858-22-000034-index.html). For the fiscal period ending 2022-12-31, Tesla posted $81,462,000,000 against General Motors' $156,735,000,000 [Ef9163ebd5b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023001409/0000950170-23-001409-index.html) [E79475160fb](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785823000029/0001467858-23-000029-index.html). For the fiscal period ending 2023-12-31, Tesla recorded $96,773,000,000 compared to General Motors' $171,842,000,000 [E11b4f42020](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html) [E05a1eabc58](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785824000031/0001467858-24-000031-index.html). Finally, for the period ending 2024-12-31, Tesla reported $97,690,000,000 while General Motors achieved $187,442,000,000 [E06fb99d6f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828025003063/0001628280-25-003063-index.html) [E16ec1705e6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/0001467858-25-000032-index.html). Both companies share concurrent annual fiscal calendars ending on December 31, allowing direct annual comparisons without calendar adjustments.

## Cross-examination

A rigorous review separates verified quantitative outcomes from qualitative management expectations. Tesla's specific capital expenditure forecast range of $7.00 to $9.00 billion for 2023 was directly testable against the reported 2023 cash PP&E purchases of $8,898,000,000, placing the outcome within the quoted range [E50fb1d1470](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000095017023033872/tsla-20230630.htm) [Ec516a365d5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024002390/0001628280-24-002390-index.html). Conversely, qualitative statements regarding future supply chain investments or unobservable funding sources cannot be verified by high-level operating cash flows or revenue metrics alone [E5d63869c15](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785823000107/gm-20230930.htm).

## Limits

- Retrospective price changes and macroeconomic datasets are subject to hindsight revisions.
- Qualitative guidance statements lack explicit numerical validation metrics.
